name: flow-chart
title: Flow chart
description: How many move from step to step: nodes in columns and links as bands as wide as their count (a Sankey diagram).

when: Paths people take between pages or states, where flows split and join.
Where a total goes, broken down over several steps.

instead.when: One ordered path where each step is a subset of the one before.
Only the counts per step matter, not where they go next.

builtIn: One tab stop: arrow keys move along a column and to the next column (mirrored in RTL); each node is named with its count and where it leads.
A "Show as table" button lists every flow with its from, to and value.
youProvide: A title that says what flows.
